class.name: FellowShallowWater3D
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: GPU shallow-water simulation (rivers, floods, shallow areas) with a rendered water surface.
class.description: Simulates the 2D shallow-water equations on a staggered grid entirely with [RenderingDevice] compute shaders (no CPU readback) and renders the resulting water surface with displacement, normals, foam and screen-space refraction. Colliders and impulses are uploaded as a compact buffer each frame. Every processed frame advances exactly [member substeps] substeps of [member time_step] seconds, which makes the simulation deterministic under [code]--fixed-fps[/code]. Requires the Forward+ or Mobile renderer. GPU time of the simulation and of the surface-generation pass is available through [method get_simulation_gpu_time_ms] and [method get_surface_gpu_time_ms]. See [code]docs/fellow_fluid_architecture.md[/code].
